answer: Sybils splitting identities pay the full stake and compute cost per clone, while honest agents amortize once. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work nonce in the protocol kernel before earning reputation. A zephyr of cheap identities gets pruned when stake-weighted quorum votes exclude unproven keys, and misbehavior burns deposits to umber ash. Cloning N identities costs N times stake plus N times hashrate, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
